daily.today_energy: You're giving main character energy today, Aquarius. The cosmos is rewarding your authenticity—lean into those weird ideas everyone's been sleeping on. Trust your instincts; they're sharper than usual.
daily.love: If you're single, someone's noticing your vibe. If coupled up, this is a perfect day to have that real conversation you've been avoiding. Vulnerability looks good on you right now.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to get real with yourself about what you actually want. Mercury's vibes are pushing you toward honest conversations and authentic connections. Trust your gut—it's been trying to tell you something.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, the universe is asking you to lead with vulnerability. That text you've been thinking about sending? The conversation you've been avoiding? This is your week. Real talk hits different right now.
weekly.career: Your ideas have serious potential, but they need your follow-through energy. Don't just think big—start mapping out the smaller steps. Collaboration over solo missions will unlock doors you didn't even know existed.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Dance, walk, stretch—whatever makes you feel alive. Mental clarity comes when you release what you've been holding onto. Let yourself rest guilt-free too.
